headlines.title: Constellation Energy (CEG) Defies the Utility Slump. Can its Nuclear Edge Drive More Gains?
headlines.summary: The overall utilities sector fell by 5.18% during the month of August, compared to the 2.62% gain for the overall market. The sector’s weakness was primarily attributed to a backup in long-term Treasury yields amid rising fiscal deficits and Treasury supply.

headlines.title: Shell and Constellation Energy Strike a $715 Million Power Deal
headlines.summary: Shell plc (NYSE:SHEL) announced on September 10 that it had agreed to sell its interest in RISEC Holdings to Constellation Energy Corporation (NYSE:CEG) for $715 million. RISEC owns the Rhode Island State Energy Center, a 609 MW natural gas electric generation facility that ​serves ⁠the New England power market.

headlines.title: Constellation Energy (CEG) Stock May Be Below Fair Value Despite $715 Million Power Plant Deal
headlines.summary: Constellation Energy has pulled back sharply in 2026 after a very strong multiyear run, which puts a spotlight on a simple question for investors who care about fundamentals: Is the current share price still in line with what the company earns? Over the past 3 years the stock has delivered a gain of 143.5%, which puts plenty of past optimism about Constellation Energy's earnings power under the microscope.

headlines.title: Here's Why Constellation Energy Corporation (CEG) Fell More Than Broader Market
headlines.summary: The latest trading day saw Constellation Energy Corporation (CEG) settling at $264.57, representing a -7.09% change from its previous close.

headlines.title: Constellation Energy in deal to buy 609-MW Rhode Island gas plant from Shell
headlines.summary: The deal expands Constellation’s ISO New England portfolio. In a separate transaction, Shell acquired a 169-MW Pennsylvania gas portfolio to grow its PJM Interconnection position.

description: Constellation Energy Corporation produces and sells energy products and services in the United States. The company operates through five segments: Mid-Atlantic, Midwest, New York, ERCOT, and Other Power Regions. It offers electricity, natural gas, energy-related products, and sustainable solutions. The company has approximately 31,676 megawatts of generating capacity consisting of nuclear, wind, solar, natural gas, and hydroelectric assets. It serves distribution utilities, municipalities, cooperatives, and commercial, industrial, public sector, and residential customers. The company was incorporated in 2021 and is headquartered in Baltimore, Maryland.
